title: The First Look
description: Vivek recalls first seeing her as she boarded a bus. He did not know her name or who she was at the time.
original_quote: The moment my eyes met you... my life found its purpose. Everything began this day.

title: The Day I Found Your ID
description: Vivek says he found her social media ID after a period of searching using her name and memory of her face/smile.
original_quote: After years of searching only with your name and the memory of your smile… I finally found you. My hands were shaking.

title: The Day I Confessed
description: Vivek says he confessed his feelings. The timeline does not state whether they were reciprocated.
original_quote: Whether you accepted it or not, loving you was the most honest thing I’ve ever done.

title: After Years, Seeing You Again
description: The timeline describes seeing her again after the confession.
original_quote: The day we saw each other after i confessed

title: The First Time You Talked to Me
description: The timeline says she spoke to Vivek and suggested they remain friends. Store this as her expressed boundary, not as romantic reciprocation.
original_quote: And when you said ‘let’s be friends’, it felt like sunlight after years of rain. Friendship with you was a blessing I never expected to receive.

title: The Days I Saw You Without You Knowing
description: Vivek recalls seeing her walk past without her noticing him.
original_quote: You walked past, unaware… but those few seconds were entire universes for me.

title: The Days I Saw You Without You Knowing
original_quote: For a moment, life felt right again. Just seeing you was enough to make my day.

title: The First Time Our Eyes Meet
description: The title suggests an eye-contact event, but the description refers to a road trip involving mountains and the ocean in the same week. The event meaning is ambiguous.
original_quote: That road trip where we saw the mountains and the ocean in the same week. Unforgettable.

title: The First Time Our Eyes Meet
description: The title refers to first eye contact, while the description refers to heartfelt words. The actual event needs clarification.
original_quote: The most honest and heartfelt words I've ever spoken. I meant every letter.

title: The Most Beautiful Day
description: Vivek describes seeing her in person for the whole day and remembers it as especially meaningful.
original_quote: Seeing you was the best gift my heart ever received. You in front of me that Whole day… I carried it inside me like a treasure.

title: When You Said 'You Deserve Better'
description: The timeline attributes the phrase 'You deserve better' to her. The page does not provide the complete conversation or context.
original_quote: You said I deserve better… But better doesn’t exist for me.

title: Your Beautiful Birthday
description: The site countdown and birthday letter identify November 29, 2025 as the birthday target/date. The timeline itself labels this event 'Today'.
original_quote: A new chapter begins. I can't wait to see all the memories you’ll make next.
